vehicle.garage.title: Garage
vehicle.garage.subtitle: {count} vehicles in this city
vehicle.garage.empty: The garage is empty. Redeem a vehicle licence and your first ride will stand here.
vehicle.tooltip.name: <#ffcf4a>{vehicle}
vehicle.tooltip.call: <#ffcf4a>Click: call the vehicle next to you
vehicle.scrap.title: Scrap it?
